name: Air-Fryer Gobi and Tofu 65
ingredients: 1 tsp Kashmiri chilli powder, ½ tsp each coriander powder and garam masala
8 curry leaves and 2 green chillies, slit
steps: Mix the besan, cornflour, yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, spices and salt into a thick paste. Coat the cauliflower and tofu.
Spray the basket, add the coated pieces in a single layer and cook for 14 minutes, shaking at 7 minutes, until crisp.
Heat the oil in a small pan and fry the curry leaves and chillies for 30 seconds.
Toss the 65 in the tempering and finish with lemon juice.
note: A tofu-boosted version of the classic fried Gobi 65.
